clauses.text: Personal data processing must be lawful, fair and transparent. Review whether AI use was adequately explained and its effects were unexpected or misleading.
clauses.review_action: request the privacy information and fairness assessment
clauses.required_evidence: Privacy information, processing purpose and records showing how the use was explained

clauses.text: Personal data must have specified legitimate purposes; later AI training needs a compatible purpose or another applicable legal route.
clauses.review_action: request the original purpose and compatibility assessment
clauses.required_evidence: Original purpose, later use and any compatibility or lawful-route assessment

clauses.text: Personal data used by AI must be adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary.
clauses.review_action: request the data-minimisation design record
clauses.required_evidence: Fields used, necessity rationale and alternatives considered

clauses.text: Personal data must be accurate and kept up to date where needed; reasonable steps must address inaccuracies without delay.
clauses.review_action: request source data, correction history and downstream recipients
clauses.required_evidence: Source data, accuracy checks, correction history and downstream disclosures

clauses.text: Identifiable personal data must not be retained longer than necessary for its purpose, subject to statutory exceptions.
clauses.review_action: request the retention schedule and deletion history
clauses.required_evidence: Applicable retention schedule, purpose and deletion or exception record

clauses.text: Personal data needs appropriate protection against unauthorised access, disclosure, unlawful processing, loss and damage.
clauses.review_action: request incident scope, access logs and containment steps
clauses.required_evidence: Incident record, access logs, affected data and containment measures

clauses.text: Every processing purpose, including AI training and deployment, needs an applicable lawful basis.
clauses.review_action: request the purpose and lawful-basis assessment
clauses.required_evidence: Processing purpose, relied-on lawful basis and supporting assessment

clauses.text: Processing health, ethnicity, identifying biometric or other special-category data needs an applicable Article 9 condition as well as an Article 6 basis.
clauses.review_action: request the special-category condition and safeguards
clauses.required_evidence: Article 6 basis, Article 9 condition, necessity and safeguards

clauses.text: Criminal conviction and offence data needs official authority or legal authorisation with safeguards; an Article 6 basis alone is insufficient.
clauses.review_action: request the conviction-data source and legal authority
clauses.required_evidence: Data source, legal authority, Article 6 basis and safeguards

clauses.text: A controller must tell a person what action it took on a subject access request without undue delay and by the applicable time period; if it takes no action it must give reasons and complaint and remedy information by that period.
clauses.review_action: request the SAR receipt, notices and response log
clauses.required_evidence: Request receipt, identity or fee requests, clarification, extension notice and response log

clauses.text: The SAR response period is normally one month from the latest relevant receipt of the request, requested identification information or fee; a complexity or volume extension needs timely notice and reasons, and a reasonable clarification request can pause the clock.
clauses.review_action: reconstruct the SAR deadline from the correspondence log
clauses.required_evidence: Request, identity and fee dates, clarification period, extension notice and final response

clauses.text: When collecting data from a person, provide the required privacy information about purposes, lawful basis and relevant automated decisions.
clauses.review_action: request the privacy notice supplied at collection
clauses.required_evidence: Collection method, notice version, delivery evidence and processing details

clauses.text: When data comes from elsewhere, provide required privacy information unless an applicable exception applies.
clauses.review_action: request the data source, notice and any relied-on exception
clauses.required_evidence: Data source, acquisition date, notice delivery and exception assessment

clauses.text: A person can request confirmation and access to personal data and required information about the processing; assess searches and exemptions.
clauses.review_action: request the search record and rationale for omitted data
clauses.required_evidence: Request scope, systems searched, disclosed material and exemption rationale

clauses.text: A person can seek rectification of inaccurate personal data without undue delay where the right applies.
clauses.review_action: request the rectification request and correction history
clauses.required_evidence: Rectification request, accuracy evidence, decision and downstream notifications

clauses.text: Erasure applies when a listed ground is met, subject to exceptions; check AI training records and retained outputs.
clauses.review_action: request the erasure assessment and retained-record inventory
clauses.required_evidence: Erasure request, relied-on ground, exceptions and deletion or retention record

clauses.text: A person may object to direct marketing profiling; after objection, personal data must no longer be processed for that marketing purpose.
clauses.review_action: request the objection and marketing suppression logs
clauses.required_evidence: Objection date, marketing purpose, suppression record and later communications

clauses.text: A decision is significant if it has a legal or similarly significant effect; solely automated means no meaningful human involvement.
clauses.review_action: request the decision log and human-involvement record
clauses.required_evidence: Decision effect, automation path and evidence of meaningful human involvement

clauses.text: A solely automated significant decision using special-category data is restricted unless a stated condition applies; Article 6(1)(ea) has its own restriction.
clauses.review_action: request the decision basis, special-category condition and safeguards
clauses.required_evidence: Automation, significant effect, data categories, applicable condition and safeguards

clauses.text: Safeguards for solely automated significant decisions include information, representations, human intervention and a way to contest.
clauses.review_action: request the notice, representation, intervention and contest records
clauses.required_evidence: Information supplied, representations, human intervention and contest route

clauses.text: Data protection measures must be built into processing design and defaults, accounting for risk and the amount of data used.
clauses.review_action: request the design record and default-control assessment
clauses.required_evidence: Design decisions, risk assessment, minimisation controls and default settings

clauses.text: Controllers and processors need security measures appropriate to the risk, including for AI suppliers and services.
clauses.review_action: request the security risk assessment and implemented controls
clauses.required_evidence: Risk assessment, technical and organisational controls, supplier terms and incident evidence

clauses.text: A data protection impact assessment is needed before processing likely to present high risk, including certain profiling or large-scale special-category processing.
clauses.review_action: request the DPIA and evidence of implemented mitigations
clauses.required_evidence: Pre-processing DPIA, risk conclusions, consultation and implemented safeguards
